To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the inclusion of textual data in a predictive model of bank distress improves the classification results with respect to a model based only on numerical data; 2) the doc2vec representation is a suitable way to represent the textual information in a way that is compatible with the standard financial data; 3) the importance of textual information is confirmed by the results of a feature ranking procedure that highlights that the textual information is more important than numerical information in the classification task.
